description: Lists every app registered by the owner (or a given Flux ID) with expiry and instance counts.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

nameContains.description: Only apps whose name contains this text.

owner.description: Flux ID to list; defaults to the configured one.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_list_my_apps
title: List apps owned by the configured Flux ID
